notes: Boot mb_10 from an empty NVRAM with the coin door open (public 22 released), navigate the service menu to T.19 DRACULA and start it, then sample the Dracula motor outputs (public 37/38, LPDC mirrors 41/42) and the five Dracula position switches 74-78 every 0.2 s, then press service Down five times and service Up five times inside the test (the screen says PRESS +/- TO MOVE DRACULA), sampling 8 s after each press. Run with --handle-mechanics 7 to enable all three of PinMAME's built-in mb_10 mechs (bit 2 is the Dracula mech mb_mech[2]: TWODIRSOL on 41/42, position switches 78/77/76/75/74 asserted over steps 0-5/18-23/36-51/64-69/85-89 of 90; bit 2 alone is the value the known-working VPX table sets), and with --handle-mechanics 3 as the control that keeps the up/down-bank and Frankenstein-table mechs but removes Dracula position feedback. Both masks enable the bank and table mechs so the power-up test report stays empty and the menu navigation lands on T.19 identically.

actions.label: boot stabilization; a fresh NVRAM shows the factory-settings and bookkeeping messages
service Escape leaves the fresh-NVRAM message loop; the ROM restarts and runs its power-up checks
service Enter: test report, or the game-information screen when the report is empty
